text: I love simple techniques. Try in the morning, after waking up, to drink a glass of warm water, but not in a hurry, rather measuredly: 3 small sips, a pause, then 3 more sips, a pause... Only 1–2 minutes. The point is not to “pour” water into yourself, but to gently activate bile secretion and peristalsis. Perhaps you will notice that the feeling of heaviness goes away, stool improves, and a feeling of lightness appears in the body and in your mood.
